mapper.sql: e.id, e.user_id, e.design_model_id, e.budget, e.area, e.address, e.description, e.status, e.created_at, e.updated_at, d.model_code AS design_model_code, d.name AS design_model_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO estimate_requests (user_id, design_model_id, budget, area, address, description, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{designModelId}, #{budget}, #{area}, #{address}, #{description}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'PENDING'))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM estimate_requests e LEFT JOIN design_models d ON d.id = e.design_model_id WHERE e.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM estimate_requests e LEFT JOIN design_models d ON d.id = e.design_model_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY e.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE estimate_requests SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
